lines.text: Sam was still on the trail when the sun went down.
He switched on his phone flashlight.
One hand on the phone, one on the rocks, and the cold ate his battery fast.
Twenty percent. His map and his only way to call were dying.
Here's the fix. Carry a separate light.
A headlamp keeps both hands free and lights the trail ahead.
Your phone stays for the map and emergencies.
Save this before your next fall hike.
